ttm.note: Latest quarterly report filed on or before 2026-10-21 is the Q2 2026 results 6-K filed 2026-08-10 (Q3 2026 results not yet filed; Oct 14 2026 6-Ks are an investor-day presentation and a 6-K without financial statements). The 6-K is the earnings-release 6-K with unaudited condensed interim statements. 2026 Convertible Notes (principal 32,933 at Dec 31 2025, due 2026-12-01): the Q1 2026 6-K (0001178913-26-002569) shows Convertible notes 487,811 and June 30 shows 488,497 vs 519,833 at Dec 31 2025, and Q2 diluted weighted shares 51,520k vs basic 46,643k imply only 2030-note dilution, so the 2026 notes are inferred settled/converted in Q1 2026; no filing located states the settlement terms, so convertibles list only the 2030 notes and carrying 488.497 is the whole balance-sheet line (2030 notes). Verify. June 30 2026 fair value of 2030 notes is not disclosed and is null. Visual Layer acquisition completed in Q2 2026 (goodwill 74.3m -> 112.7m, intangibles 10.1m -> 16.7m); acquisition consideration, deferred/contingent consideration and retention awards are not in the 6-K and are not captured in otherClaims. Operating-lease and finance-lease liabilities and RSU/option counts are Dec 31 2025 carried values. The June 30 convertible fair value is null; the former carried December 31 fair value has been removed from this period. Contractual terms remain sourced to the annual filing.
